Main.dc.html.title: M5Paper S3 · Areas, room lights + Sonos (540×960)

spec.text:
M5Paper S3 — 4.7" e-ink, 540×960 portrait (USB-C at the bottom), GT911 touch.

Pure black and white only (no grey), so every refresh uses the fast black/white mode (~0.4 s); a full flash clears ghosting now and then.

Bottom bar switches pages: Areas (lights) and Sonos.

Areas: tap anywhere on a room's row to toggle its lights; hold it to open that room's lights (on/off, brightness bar: tap where you want it, 10 % steps) and, for Kitchen and Living Room, the emma scenes. Switch the board's "startPage" to "room" and pick a "room" to preview one. Sonos: tick rooms on the left; tap the rest of a speaker's row to play/pause (grouped speakers play/pause together). Playlists and volume (-5 / -2 / +2 / +5 %) act on the ticked rooms.

Filled black = on / playing, white = off / paused, no button = unavailable. Every touch clicks the buzzer.

Power off ("Power off" in Home Assistant, a 2 s hold on the battery at the top right, or an empty battery) leaves the "Slukket" screen on the e-ink — switch the board's "screen" setting to preview it. The side button's double-press can't show it: that button only reaches the power chip.
